name: TASK_OBJECTIVE_LIFECYCLE_REVIEW_V1
task_execution_projection: fold append-only task_execution_events in deterministic recorded_at_utc,event_id order while applying correction events to exact target evidence

exact no-history authority has no task_execution_projection row and no task_execution_events; readers expose logical execution_state=not_started with execution_revision=0 as an absence freshness token without fabricating a persisted row/event. Once any execution event exists, task_execution_projection must exist with positive revision even when corrections make the current-effective logical state not_started; event history without its required projection fails closed as integrity drift
not_started: no current-effective start and no current-effective termination/cancel event
in_progress: one current-effective start exists and no current-effective end/termination closes it
ended: current-effective start and end exist, end>=start, and no later effective termination supersedes the open execution interpretation

terminated: current-effective manual_cancel/rfc_terminal_terminate/source_terminal_consequence closes executable work; actual_start remains null when no accepted start, otherwise preserves actual start; termination does not fabricate actual end
a correction may replace/withdraw exact occurrence time only when the resulting full chronology remains valid; prior evidence remains immutable
recorded_at is never substituted for an unknown/missing effective occurrence time
task_revision_freshness: tasks.revision is the umbrella freshness token for material Task-owned mutable authority. Every material accepted plan, relationship, explicit-lock, activity-lineage classification, execution, reviewed-outcome or governed local terminal-consequence mutation increments it exactly once unless the owning command explicitly declares a separate immutable topology that intentionally leaves Task revision unchanged, such as LinkWfmRetryAttempt

owned sub-projection revisions remain independent freshness tokens and advance according to their own material mutation; advancing tasks.revision never substitutes for revalidating the exact execution/outcome/plan/lock/membership authority required by a command

cross-domain captures that bind Task revision, including RFC-terminal Task participation, therefore cannot cross an unseen material local execution/outcome change even when that caller does not carry every LLD-05 sub-projection revision
task_review_state: if task_outcome_current exists and its event remains valid against corrected execution evidence, review_state=reviewed with accepted outcome/reviewed_at
otherwise if execution_state in ended|terminated, review_state=awaiting_review
otherwise if current Objective envelope is due/past and Task still has no accepted outcome, surface awaiting_review/due_unreviewed without creating execution or outcome

completed: requires execution_state=ended with accepted actual_start and actual_end
does not accept provider Complete, Objective end, review time or termination alone as completion
incomplete: requires accepted actual_start and execution_state in ended|terminated
reason_category required when the current evidence does not itself explain incompleteness
cancelled_without_execution: requires no current-effective accepted actual_start and execution_state=terminated
manual_cancel, RFC terminal consequence or reviewed source-terminal consequence may supply termination evidence; provider status by itself may not

correction_rule: ordinary ReviewTaskOutcome cannot overwrite an existing current accepted outcome; use CorrectTaskOutcome
CorrectTaskOutcome appends a new event correction_of exact current event and must satisfy the current corrected execution matrix
Task identity, execution evidence, prior outcome event and reviewed_at remain preserved
a correction that materially changes an Objective aggregate invalidates the prior Objective review fingerprint but never edits/deletes objective_review_events

plan_lock_true_if: provider terminal evidence whose local consequence is protected/unresolved
terminal/historical Objective membership where plan rewrite would alter protected structure
membership_lock_true_if: protected retry/history consequence that would be rewritten by move
effective_locks.rule: current UTC clock crossing a plan boundary never creates either lock by itself; corrections use their explicit governed path rather than pretending the lock does not exist

task_executable.true_when: Task has no current-effective termination/cancelled outcome, is not provider/local terminal work retained as historical-only, and domain-specific RFC/WFM eligibility allows execution
false_when: provider Plan Cancel/Complete local consequence accepted as termination
RFC terminal cascade applied to the Task
task_executable.rule: provider status alone does not flip local executable=false until the governed local consequence decision/cascade applies, except a purely historical Task created/adopted from already-terminal provider evidence that never entered active executable state

objective_aggregate_derivation: load current nonsuperseded Objective membership, each pinned plan revision, Task execution projection, Task current outcome, operational-count inclusion and current valid review fingerprint
envelope=min pinned plan start / max pinned plan end; member_count must be >0
actual_start_utc=min accepted actual_start across member Tasks when any exists; otherwise null

actual_end_utc is null while any started member remains in_progress; when at least one Task started and all started Tasks are terminal, use max(actual_end_utc or effective_termination_utc) across those started Tasks with known terminal occurrence; unknown terminal occurrence leaves aggregate actual_end unknown
if Objective is superseded => execution_state=superseded and no new editable aggregate outcome

else if creation_origin=historical_provider_complete and no accepted Task actual execution exists => execution_state=historical_structure; aggregate_outcome is null unless all current members are excluded from operational counts, then excluded_from_operational_counts
else if any member execution_state=in_progress => execution_state=in_progress

else if Objective has evidence that at least one member began execution and a governed transition leaves zero executable members before all Task outcomes are reviewed => execution_state=awaiting_review with attention_reason=lost_last_executable

else if all current member Tasks have valid current accepted outcomes => derive aggregate outcome; execution_state=reviewed only when a current objective_review_event fingerprint matches exact membership/outcome/inclusion inputs, otherwise awaiting_review
else if current time >= envelope.end_utc => execution_state=awaiting_review with attention_reason=due_unreviewed; no Task outcome is fabricated
if current task_plan_current differs from a membership-pinned plan revision for any current member, add attention_reason=plan_membership_mismatch unless a higher safety attention reason is present

objective_outcome_derivation.included_population: current members whose effective operational-count inclusion is true; exclusions never delete membership/history
objective_outcome_derivation.excluded_all: when included population is empty and at least one member is excluded => excluded_from_operational_counts
objective_outcome_derivation.cancelled: all included member outcomes are cancelled_without_execution AND no current or corrected historical member actual_start exists
objective_outcome_derivation.completed: all included member outcomes are completed
objective_outcome_derivation.incomplete: all included member outcomes are incomplete OR mixture of completed/incomplete containing at least one incomplete and no cancelled outcome only when the UI/report chooses normalized failure class; canonical stored aggregate remains mixed for heterogeneous outcomes
objective_outcome_derivation.mixed: two or more distinct included Task outcome tokens are present
objective_outcome_derivation.rule: canonical aggregate uses mixed for any heterogeneous Task outcomes; whole-Objective Cancelled is therefore impossible after any Task began execution

objective_review_fingerprint.fields: version; objective_id/revision; sorted current task_id + membership revision + pinned plan revision + execution revision where 0 means exact no-history execution authority + current outcome event/revision + inclusion revision/default; supersession state
objective_review_fingerprint.rule: reviewed_at is server recording time after exact fingerprint revalidation; it does not enter actual execution chronology

source_terminal_review: when accepted LLD-04 WFM projection changes to Complete or Plan Cancel, provider source status remains immutable evidence/current source projection only

if the Task still has local executable work or Objective consequence, create/supersede wfm_source_terminal_reviews pending row bound to exact source projection revision and local input fingerprint; do not append execution/outcome evidence

local input fingerprint includes task revision, execution revision/state where revision 0 means exact no-history execution authority, outcome revision, current plan revision, membership objective/pin/revision, effective locks and provider source projection revision
retain_local_work records the reviewed decision only; a later materially changed source/local state may create a fresh review
terminate_local_work appends one source_terminal_consequence execution event in the same UoW and transitions the exact review; no Task outcome is added

after termination rebuild affected Objective aggregate; if it was in progress and now has zero executable Tasks set lost_last_executable/awaiting review, otherwise preserve surviving work and show source-terminal warning
Plan Cancel/Complete source evidence never changes SR/RFC lifecycle, Inventory or Communications through this command
rfc_terminal_participant: capture_applicable_wfms under LLD-03 caller UoW selects exact active locally executable WFM Tasks whose current owning RFC is in the exact cascade RFC set; returns ordered task_id/task revision/task_no
preview reports affected Objectives, surviving executable counts and any in-progress last-executable loss; any incomplete authority returns INDETERMINATE

writer revalidation recomputes the complete current Task/Objective impact set under the LLD-03 caller UoW and exact-compares the reviewed exact_count/provider_fingerprint before deliberate proof consumption

apply is called only after both cross-domain revalidations are READY, deliberate proof is consumed and the outer LLD-03 command receipt exists; it receives RfcTerminalCascadeExecutionCommandContextV1 for exact command/actor/review provenance and no proof/session secret

apply revalidates captured identities/revisions/ownership, appends rfc_terminal_terminate execution events for applicable Tasks only, advances every materially affected tasks.revision and execution projection revision exactly once, and rebuilds affected Objective projections; provider source projection remains untouched and no Task outcome is accepted

every Task/Objective consequence/history/audit row created by the apply is provider-owned and references command_context.command_id as its outer command provenance; no nested receipt/commit/rollback is opened

after all provider-owned writes are assembled, compute SOMA_RFC_TERMINAL_CASCADE_PARTICIPANT_RESULT_V1 over domain TASKS_OBJECTIVES, outer command_id, proposal_id and the complete deterministic ordered immutable result refs plus provider audit_event_ids; return only RfcTerminalCascadeParticipantApplyResultV1 with exact result_ref_count, audit_event_count and result_fingerprint

the apply summary is bounded post-apply correlation evidence only; no product/business maximum is imposed on Task/Objective consequence cardinality and the complete result set never crosses into LLD-03 audit
unrelated Local Tasks and WFM Tasks outside the exact RFC scope are untouched
all Task/Objective projection rebuilds occur in caller UnitOfWork and any failure rolls the entire RFC cascade back
objective_cancel: whole Objective cancel command first proves no current-effective or historical-uncorrected Task start exists for any member
it records explicit cancellation evidence/outcome per Task rather than writing an Objective-owned cancellation truth
aggregate Cancelled follows only from member outcomes and valid Objective review fingerprint
